$comment: Spark variant: Gemini 2.5 Pro manager + max-everything worker pool.
Cost rationale: Gemini 2.5 Pro is Google's frontier reasoning model.
Tests cross-family routing under a third-family manager.
Effort: Gemini 2.5 Pro on OpenRouter exposes `reasoning_effort` with
values low|medium|high (no `max` or `xhigh` tier). We use 'high' — the
top tier Gemini accepts. We do NOT normalize to 'max' across providers;
the recorded eval-result reflects the provider-native value actually sent.
